scope: Only common-grid p5=x[b0]*s2+y[b1]+v[b3]*s4 with s2,s4 in {-2,-1}, four d7 records at offsets 0,4,8,12, and 32 distinct p5 addresses. Other encodings, record placements, arithmetic graphs and wrapping outside a compact real memory interval are not excluded.
proof: Any span <=50 grid cells bounds every x/v coefficient and the y difference by 49; all 4-element contribution shapes are enumerated. For each distinct 16-element pairwise sumset, the minimum disjoint translation of the two y choices gives the minimum possible span.
